verdict.rationale: Bitbucket Pipelines automations are defined as YAML files stored in the repo, so they inherit standard git versioning, PR-based review (docs-11, docs-24) and rollback via revert, and docs-4/docs-18 describe pipeline-based AI workflow automation. However, no evidence explicitly discusses versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automation configs themselves as a distinct workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of pipeline-config version history/diff view, dedicated rollback tooling for automations, and any hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
